data.description:
## Summary

Non-destructive investigation into the environment propagation chain that exports `GIT_DIR`, `GIT_WORK_TREE`, and `GIT_CONFIG*` into agent/test sessions. This uses `/proc/<pid>/environ` inspection, git `trace2` (`GIT_TRACE2_EVENT`), and launcher/hook inspection to produce reproducible evidence without mutating the live checkout.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `/proc/<pid>/environ` of an active agent/pane process is captured (or a representative trace is produced) showing the inherited environment.
- [ ] Git `trace2` (`GIT_TRACE2_EVENT`) around `git worktree add` and hook execution demonstrates where repository-overriding variables are set.
- [ ] The full propagation chain is documented: which process first sets the variable, through which intermediaries, and into which final target.
- [ ] Evidence is recorded as a comment on this work item with non-destructive proof.
- [ ] A controlled fresh-session env dump proves the end-to-end state (one controlled run).

## Implementation

1. **Inspect git hooks and trace2:** Use `GIT_TRACE2_EVENT` to capture the environment at hook execution time. Create a throwaway repo to test `git worktree add` and verify whether git itself sets repository-overriding vars in the hook subprocess environment.
2. **Inspect ContextHub spawn options:** Review `buildDowntimeSpawnOptions` in `downtime-worker.ts` — it spreads `...process.env`, confirming a propagation path if the herdr process itself has a repository override set.
3. **Inspect send-to-pi.sh and run-pi-agent.sh:** Confirm they do not set or filter git variables.
4. **One controlled env dump:** Spawn a single agent session and capture its environment before any `git` touch.

## Key Files

- `skill/shared/git_sandbox.py` — `REPOSITORY_OVERRIDE_ENV_VARS` list for reference.
- `skill/test/scripts/run_tests.py` — scrub infrastructure.
- `docs/dev/test-isolation.md` §9.3 — current residual risk documentation.
- `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.ts` — `buildDowntimeSpawnOptions` (ContextHub).
- `packages/herdr/shared/send-to-pi.sh`, `packages/herdr/shared/run-pi-agent.sh` — launcher scripts (ContextHub).
- `.githooks/post-checkout|post-merge|post-rewrite`, `worklog-post-pull` — hook chain.
data.title: GIT_DIR evidence: trace non-destructive env propagation path
